text: あつめるのは　たいへん　だったろ！

structure.jp: たいへん　だったろ！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. あつめるの = 'collecting'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.span: たいへん　だったろ
patterns.explanation: だろう means 'probably' or 'I bet'; だったろ is its past form, cut short in casual speech. たいへん　だったろ = 'it must have been hard'.
